slices.description: The @mesh/@kv YNGENIOS service surface: what must change so the ring rides the REAL ynet mesh (MeshNodeRuntime DI resolve is null => Unavailable today) WITHOUT violating wrap-never-replace (FR-010).

The DV mesh + link transports: whether a RING pins the path and bypasses DV next-hop routing (and therefore what a 1M-cycle ring soak actually proves), plus the split fail policy (bad-sig HALTS vs link-drop REROUTES+counts) against MeshSendOutcome. NOTE: read these paths as they exist at this commit.

Signing + durable chain + measured evidence: SealSet reuse over re-impl, the fsync/group-commit throughput floor that binds the 1M budget (fsync, not BLE), CRC-frame resume, and whether the recorded bench numbers honestly support the cycle arithmetic.

The coin ledger's replication + endorsement surface: whether ICoinLedger.MergeFrom is in fact implemented and dot-keyed, whether folding peer ops bypasses the admission checks where conservation/no-negative/exactly-once are enforced, what a correct re-validation-before-projection actually requires, and whether an auto-endorsed relay-hop class can be corroborated by evidence the claimant cannot forge.
